newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MIERA TO COACH ESPANYOL AFTER CARCELEN RESIGNS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIERA TO COACH ESPANYOL AFTER CARCELEN RESIGNS.

text.p: Pepe Carcelen resigned as coach of Spanish first division club Espanyol on Monday.
He is to be replaced by Vicente Miera, who had a spell as manager at the Sarria ground in 1981.

Carcelen, who is expected to stay on at the club, took over at Espanyol after Jose Antonio Camacho left for Sevilla in the close season. But the former deputy coach saw his side knocked out of the UEFA Cup and slump to 16th in the league.
